title: Update the Couchbase dissector
description:
Update the Couchbase dissector:

1. Add missing status codes
2. Add missing ifconfig command (and move incorrectly placed commands to make command id sorted)
3. Print VBuckets as vb:<num> (not hex) as thats the format used in Couchbase logs

notes.body: I couldn't merge this branch: Insufficient approvals (have: [] missing: 1)
I couldn't merge this branch: CI failed!
